---
title: "Ecosystem Roadmap"
---

The `measure` ecosystem spans scientific packages ([`measure`](https://github.com/JamesHWade/measure/), [`measure.sec`](https://github.com/JamesHWade/measure.sec/), and future technique packs) alongside the operational MCP service (`measure-service`). Tracking stays cleanly separated by layer. [**`measure #44`**](https://github.com/JamesHWade/measure/issues/44) serves as the ecosystem roadmap hub, while service-specific contracts, hosting, and campaigns are tracked in **`measure-service`**.

## Ownership principle

- **`measure` & technique packs** own measurement data models, open-format codecs, preprocessing/deconvolution/calibration algorithms, analytical validation statistics, and scientific reference benchmarks.
- **`measure-service`** owns MCP tool contracts, durable SQLite/snapshot storage, multi-user sharing/auth, hosted deployment operations, campaign/BO orchestration, and thin adapters exposing capabilities from `measure` and its technique packs.

## Cross-repo analytical expansion (`measure` ↔ `measure-service`)

As analytical domains mature in `measure` and dedicated technique packs, `measure-service` exposes them through matching MCP tool groups and evidence contracts:

| Analytical domain | Backend ownership (`measure` / packs) | Service exposure (`measure-service`) | Planning links |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Scalar LC, GC & CE** | Reproducible calibrated batch quantitation & QC | Batches, snapshots, evidence views, and calibrated batch MCP flows | [measure #80](https://github.com/JamesHWade/measure/issues/80), [#84](https://github.com/JamesHWade/measure/issues/84), [#203](https://github.com/JamesHWade/measure/issues/203) |
| **SEC / GPC** | Explicit concentration units & mass normalization in `measure.sec` | Relative SEC analysis & comparison tools | [measure #51](https://github.com/JamesHWade/measure/issues/51), [measure.sec #60](https://github.com/JamesHWade/measure.sec/issues/60) |
| **DAD & spectral deconvolution** | LC-DAD/PDA deconvolution, purity, and MOCCA2 parity cases | 2D plane/region inspection shipped. Deconvolution and purity views are next. | [measure #88](https://github.com/JamesHWade/measure/issues/88) |
| **LC–MS & GC–MS** | Open-format MS records, targeted annotation, cross-run identity | Native acquisition and scan-linked XIC shipped. Annotation and correspondence views are next. | [measure #53](https://github.com/JamesHWade/measure/issues/53), [#85](https://github.com/JamesHWade/measure/issues/85), [#98](https://github.com/JamesHWade/measure/issues/98), [#99](https://github.com/JamesHWade/measure/issues/99) |
| **Retention & method spaces** | Physicochemical LSS/QSS/Neue–Kuss fitting, method spaces, and paper–code audit | Declared ideal predictions shipped. Fitted model profiles and bounded search spaces are next. | [measure #92](https://github.com/JamesHWade/measure/issues/92), [#93](https://github.com/JamesHWade/measure/issues/93), [#100](https://github.com/JamesHWade/measure/issues/100), [#108](https://github.com/JamesHWade/measure/issues/108) |
| **Thermal, spectroscopy & validation** | Technique packs for DSC/TGA/DMA, FTIR/Raman, NMR, XRD, spectral imaging, interchange, and ICH/USP validation | Expose validated workflows & reports over MCP as each pack reaches reference maturity | [measure #44](https://github.com/JamesHWade/measure/issues/44), [#52](https://github.com/JamesHWade/measure/issues/52), [#54](https://github.com/JamesHWade/measure/issues/54)–[#59](https://github.com/JamesHWade/measure/issues/59), [#204](https://github.com/JamesHWade/measure/issues/204) |

::: {.callout-important title="Completion standard"}
A roadmap item is complete only when its public contract, executable example, reference datasets/tolerances, provenance, and failure behavior are both documented and tested. Synthetic checks prove only the paths they run. Real-instrument or manuscript-reproduction claims require named datasets, protocol versions, baselines, and explicit limitations.
:::
